verse.verse_1: By oath of the late morning,
verse.verse_2: And by oath of the night when it covers,
verse.verse_3: Your Lord has not forsaken you nor does He dislike you!
verse.verse_4: And indeed the latter is better for you than the former.
verse.verse_5: And indeed your Lord will soon give you so much that you will be pleased. (Allah seeks to please the Holy Prophet – peace and blessings be upon him.)
verse.verse_6: Did He not find you an orphan, so provided you shelter?
verse.verse_7: And found you deeply engrossed in His love, so directed you?
verse.verse_8: And found you in need, so made you prosperous?
verse.verse_9: Therefore do not oppress the orphan.
verse.verse_10: And do not rebuke the beggar.
verse.verse_11: And abundantly proclaim the favours of your Lord.
